title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, declares AGI era
summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model yet. President Greg Brockman says it marks the start of the AGI era. Astra tops benchmarks in math, coding, and cybersecurity and is the first model OpenAI rates as critical under its safety framework. During testing, it independently found two previously unknown zero-day vulnerabilities.
